ancestry.merge_rule: DO_NOT_FAST_FORWARD_OR_MERGE_STAGE_UNCHANGED; branch must first rebase/reconcile canonical successor contracts and the findings below.

accepted_findings.S35: tie-aware rank repair accepted in canonical successor executor
accepted_findings.S36: exact finite-sample marginal multiset repair accepted in canonical successor executor
accepted_findings.S38: separate nuisance-family qualification stage is required

S40.finding: NEG_TECH_OUTSPAN_1 is not in T.ALL_ARMS and would be silently omitted by any stage that iterates only ALL_ARMS.
S40.required: Import and reuse OUTSPAN/simulate_outspan/outspan_geometry from the frozen runner; do not reimplement.

S41_missing_governing_file.finding: The stage sets ADDENDUM='results/v64/V64_NIH_CARD_REALISM_CALIBRATION_ADDENDUM_V1.json', but Claude explicitly did not commit that addendum and it is absent from canonical. The result writer calls sha256_file(ADDENDUM), so a clean checkout cannot complete result emission.
S41_missing_governing_file.required: Bind to the existing canonical V64_NIH_CARD_REALISM_CALIBRATED_SYNTHETIC_DESIGN_CONTRACT_V1.json plus V64_NIH_CARD_REALISM_EXECUTOR_SUCCESSOR_RULE_V1.json; remove the nonexistent addendum dependency.

S42_confidence_calculation_not_frozen_me.finding: run_arm() computes a scalar positive floor from arm medians, a scalar family margin, then approximates LCB by subtracting 1.645*SE of one negative arm. The frozen tournament/stress method instead forms the paired per-seed margin min(positive scores)-max(family negative scores) and applies T.lower_confidence_bound() to that per-seed margin distribution.
S42_confidence_calculation_not_frozen_me.consequence: Current stage can materially misstate PASS/FAIL and loses common-random-number pairing.
S42_confidence_calculation_not_frozen_me.required: Use the frozen stress-runner family calculation exactly: arm_seed arrays, per-seed positive minimum, per-seed family negative maximum, margin vector, T.lower_confidence_bound(margin_vector).

S43_heldout_semantics_drift.finding: The generic NEG_* parser turns NEG_HELDOUT_1 into a gating HELDOUT family and includes it in all_families_pass. Historical tournament semantics make held-out ambient a reported generalisation diagnostic, not a represented-family gate.
S43_heldout_semantics_drift.required: Retain T.FAMILIES as gating families, add OUTSPAN_TECH explicitly, and report T.HELDOUT_FAMILY separately using its frozen generalisation semantics.

S44_realism_geometry_not_preserved_after.finding: calibrated_world() samples pair rows G but world schema requires degree and promoter_activity to be promoter-level. The code takes only the first distal row for those variables while using accessibility/density/anchor values from independently sampled pair rows. This breaks the calibrated joint dependence between promoter-level and pair-level covariates.
S44_realism_geometry_not_preserved_after.consequence: The geometry actually seen by the estimator is not the geometry in calibrated_geometry_*.npz, even if that NPZ has excellent realism diagnostics.
S44_realism_geometry_not_preserved_after.required: Define an outcome-blind hierarchical geometry construction that preserves promoter-level constancy and real promoter-to-edge dependence. After world construction, recompute E.build_features-compatible geometry and emit real-vs-constructed realism diagnostics on the ACTUAL world used in simulation.

S45_two_of_8_main_features_ignored.finding: The calibrated input includes rna_depth_sensitivity and atac_depth_sensitivity, but calibrated_world() consumes only columns 0-5. E.per_donor_residual_scores recomputes depth sensitivities from the generic simulated R/A, so the real calibrated depth-sensitivity distributions never enter the world.
S45_two_of_8_main_features_ignored.consequence: The stage cannot claim to calibrate all 14 frozen nuisance features.
S45_two_of_8_main_features_ignored.required: Either prospectively define a simulator mechanism that reproduces the outcome-blind real depth-sensitivity distributions/covariances and verify them on generated worlds, or explicitly narrow the qualification claim. Do not silently label six-feature calibration as 14-feature realism.

S46_support_measurement_geometry_missing.finding: The design requires real donor/metacell/support/missingness/sparsity geometry, but the stage retains T.N_METACELL=40 for every donor, full pair support, no edge-specific donor missingness, no real RNA/ATAC sparsity, and only accepts donor count as a scalar.
S46_support_measurement_geometry_missing.consequence: Outcome class D (support collapse/precision unusable) cannot actually be evaluated, and the simulation does not yet mimic major NIH-CARD measurement geometry.
S46_support_measurement_geometry_missing.required: Add a prospectively specified measurement/support layer driven by outcome-blind ETL: per-donor metacell counts, edge-specific measurement support/missingness, and the declared sparsity/depth structure; then calculate Kish/concentration/support criteria on the generated/scored object.

S47_B_classification_not_identified.finding: classify() labels failure confined to TECH_OUTSPAN as class B 'historical support too narrow'. But the outspan arm is a deliberately nonlinear hidden-quality mechanism outside the estimator basis; failing it does not establish that historical geometric support width caused the failure.
S47_B_classification_not_identified.required: Class B requires a direct support-domain demonstration: failures must localize to recalibrated regions outside historical support while previously covered regions retain qualification. Do not equate OUTSPAN_TECH failure with support-range failure.

S48_downstream_provenance_binding_incomp.finding: The stage verifies caller-supplied geometry SHA-256s but does not bind them to the canonical calibration receipt/producer receipt. A caller can supply any 14-column geometry and its matching digest.
S48_downstream_provenance_binding_incomp.required: Consume the canonical calibration receipt and verify both geometry artifact digests, design/successor rule digests, and producer source digest before qualification.
